objective: V3.9.9 — Context That Feeds (Memory + Handoff Intelligence): better memory entering better handoffs — right context to the right agent at the right time.
context: V3.9.8 Runtime Hardening shipped (#50–#55). Crowley already has memory_items types, hybrid retrieval with score_breakdown, and build_agent_sync_bundle — but sync dumps too much, saves noisy memories, and does not explain why each memory was included. V3.9.9 filters on the way in, explains on the way out, slims agent sync.
decisions: Theme: Context That Feeds — not more memory, better memory entering better handoffs
One ticket at a time — claim, implement, self-QA, approval, close, next
Post-work feedback loop on both Cursor (--after) and Codex sync paths
Use existing schema where possible: summary for why_it_matters, project slug for scope; migrate only if gate requires it
No version bump / doc lock until ticket #63
Cursor mints only — do not claim until Mr. Go assigns first ticket
non_goals: Destructive auto-delete of memories or loops
risks: Quality gate must not reject legitimate handoffs or block ingest
Slim sync must not hide filesystem/ticket authority per MEMORY_HIERARCHY
Inclusion reasons must stay deterministic in tests (no live model)
qa_expectations: CROWLEY_TEST_MODE=1 CROWLEY_EMBED_PROVIDER=off full unittest; agent sync bundle shape tests; memory gate unit tests; node --check static/app.js for UI ticket
next_action: Mr. Go assigns first ticket; Cursor claims #56 only when directed

approval.note: Mint approved; feedback loop on both Cursor and Codex; do not claim on mint

tickets.title: V3.9.9 Context: memory quality gate
tickets.description: Gate save paths (sparks, extraction, handoff-derived memories) to promote only high-value types: decision, constraint, preference, lesson, qa_result, active project facts. Reject or demote vague event noise and low-confidence extraction. Every promoted memory requires why_it_matters (use summary column initially), scope (active project slug), importance 1-5, confidence 0-1. Files: crowley.py save_memory_item and extraction/spark callers.
acceptance: Noisy/low-signal saves rejected or demoted in unit tests
Promoted memories include why_it_matters, scope, importance, confidence
ALLOWED types enforced at gate; handoff prose not duplicated as raw event rows
No schema migration required unless tests prove summary insufficient

tickets.title: V3.9.9 Context: retrieval inclusion reasons
tickets.description: Upgrade _build_retrieval_explanation to human-readable inclusion_reason (e.g. Pulled because: matches open ticket #57 + constraint memory). Expose on /api/retrieve results and relevant_memories in sync bundle. Optional one-line form in build_prompt supporting-memory section.
acceptance: Every retrieve_memories result includes inclusion_reason string
Reason cites match factors: ticket, type, constraint, recency, or handoff link
Deterministic fixture tests; no live model calls
Backward compat: score_breakdown retained alongside inclusion_reason

tickets.title: V3.9.9 Context: slim agent sync bundle
tickets.description: Refactor build_agent_sync_bundle to agent-scoped capped bundle: current ticket(s) for assignee, active blockers, recent decisions (5), constraints memories (5), last 5 cross-agent events, relevant memories (5-8) with inclusion reasons. Demote open_tasks, full loops dump, canon wall from default sync. Update agent_sync_lib print_agent_sync_bundle for readable output. Files: crowley.py, scripts/agent_sync_lib.py.
acceptance: /api/agent/sync returns slim shape with documented caps
Cursor sync shows assigned ticket + blockers before memories
Codex sync shows planning context without giant dump
Tests assert bundle size caps and required keys per agent role

tickets.title: V3.9.9 Context: handoff to memory upgrade
tickets.description: Upgrade ingest_handoff extraction to promote decisions, constraints, lessons through memory quality gate instead of bulk project_update rows. Parse handoff sections (Decisions, Constraints, Lessons) into typed memory_items with why_it_matters.
acceptance: Handoff with ## Decisions creates gated decision memories
Handoff with constraint/lesson sections create typed rows with why_it_matters
Bulk handoff body not saved as duplicate low-value event when sections extracted
ingest tests cover accept and reject paths

tickets.title: V3.9.9 Context: post-work feedback loop (Cursor + Codex)
tickets.description: After agent work, capture structured outcomes: state change, new decision, or lesson learned. Wire Cursor scripts/cursor_sync.py --after and Codex scripts/codex_sync.py handoff paths to optional structured sections or flags that feed save_memory_item through quality gate. Prompt template in handoff scaffold for Lesson / Decision / State changed blocks.
acceptance: cursor_sync --after can emit lesson/decision blocks into handoff ingest
codex_sync architect_handoff path supports same structured blocks
Structured blocks create gated memory_items; empty blocks skipped
Tests for both agents; no chat UI popup required

tickets.title: V3.9.9 Context: handoff-ticket wiring
tickets.description: Surface linked_ticket_ids in agent activity and sync bundle. Ticket lines show linked handoff summary. Audit --after --ticket close path for handoff_linked events and linked_memory_id population.
acceptance: Sync bundle agent_activity shows handoff to ticket links
Ticket close via cursor_sync links handoff memory_id
Prompt or sync output shows handoff #N closed ticket #M
Tests for link path; no agent-to-agent channel

tickets.title: V3.9.9 Context: light UI and hygiene report
tickets.description: Light UI: Agent Feed shows inclusion_reason badges on memories; optional hygiene callout for stale/noisy candidates. node --check static/app.js passes
